folds.heading: ## Scope and evidence qualification, 2026-11-04 (B26)
folds.body: The inspected schema/service absence and held planning stage above are October 4 snapshots, not present capability claims or an instruction to build this entire bank first. Preserve the conceptual separation of reference, authored policy, actual state, attributed evidence and derived view, with semantic receipt criteria beyond hashes. A selected action needs complete relevant support and safe observer projection, not every bank record. Revision-bound indexes are replaceable navigation; they do not become another source of truth. Current accepted direction and native owners decide which concrete adapter is needed, while AD51 governs shared-foundation/lead validation sequencing. No query service, schema migration or performance saving was implemented or measured here.
